independence_statement: I am the separately delegated read-only reviewer, not the translating worker. I read the complete actual canonical Arabic and each complete actual English and Indonesian target directly, independently comparing each target with the Arabic. I did not edit either target or rely on the translator's conclusions. The parent's reported structural validation was not treated as semantic approval. This decision binds only the exact raw file hashes below.

coverage.details: Computed all three SHA-256 hashes from actual raw bytes and asserted equality with the assigned identities. Each target begins with Arabic: followed by all 4634 canonical source bytes unchanged. Splitting at its target-language label leaves exactly those source bytes plus one wrapper-separator newline, not a normalized or reconstructed source. Exactly one Arabic label and one appropriate target label were verified in each wrapper.

coverage.check: Complete independent bilingual reading and style contract
coverage.details: Read docs/translation-style-v2.md and the canonical-page-alignment reference. Read all eight canonical source lines and every target line, including the previously display-truncated continuations of the long third and fourth sections. Compared English directly with Arabic and Indonesian directly with Arabic, rather than using one target as the other target's semantic authority. No omitted source clause or unsupported completion was identified.

coverage.details: Both targets preserve -- 92 -- as their own opening folio line. Tool extraction confirmed five sections and the source/target per-section star counts [0, 0, 1, 3, 0], preserving their placement around the return transition and seal passage. The separate unfinished final source line من remains a separate final from/dari line, without continuation from a neighboring page.

Kertas merah, sesuatu yang berat, nama orang yang engkau kehendaki serta nama ibunya are followed immediately by kecuali dalam keluarnya darah; the damaged construction is flagged without erasing the exception.

coverage.details: Cross-checked both entire targets for conditional antecedents, absolute no-harm/even-if scope, if-return and if-reverse conditions, one in the damaged al-aṣḥiyya clause, except-in-bleeding scope, and will-not-cease/until scope. Reviewed plural persons/addressees, plural servants and Names, all persons/all armies, attributes of the seal, pregnant women, bodily openings, worlds and souls. No list member was dropped or silently substituted; no recipe arithmetic was performed.

coverage.check: Source editorial brackets versus target uncertainty markers
coverage.details: Tool extraction identified exactly the source editorial contents متن and يهلك. These remain separately bracketed as [body]/[bagian tubuh] and [perishes]/[binasa], respectively, and are not conflated with the explanatory [UNCLEAR: ...] annotations. The latter annotations are localized and their Indonesian descriptions are in Indonesian.

Both translations identify the efficacy statements as claims of the text, preserve the historical source's imperatives, and neither recommend the operations nor certify the claims. The source's protective, medical and harmful assertions remain inconsistent where the source is inconsistent. No practical augmentation, derived measurement, corrected formula or calculated recipe was added.

coverage.details: Tool checks found no non-Latin letters apart from the explicitly allowed transliteration modifiers, no non-ASCII decimal digits, and no hidden format/surrogate characters in either target. Its ar/en/id strings equal the actual corresponding file blocks under dataset outer trimming; this is a separate structural observation, not a substitute for the full semantic review above.
